checked-add.source: int op(uint64_t a,uint64_t b,uint64_t *out) { if (UINT64_MAX-a < b) return 1; *out=a+b; return 0; }

decimal.source: int op(const char *s,uint64_t *out) { uint64_t value=0; if (!*s) return 1; for (;*s;++s) { if (*s<'0' || *s>'9') return 1; uint64_t digit=(uint64_t)(*s-'0'); if (value>(UINT64_MAX-digit)/10) return 1; value=value*10+digit; } *out=value; return 0; }

copy.source: int op(unsigned char *out,size_t capacity,const unsigned char *source,size_t length) { if (length>capacity) return 1; memcpy(out,source,length); return 0; }
cases: unsigned char out[4]={91,91,91,91}; const unsigned char source[4]={1,2,3,4}; assert(op(out,4,source,2)==0 && out[0]==1 && out[1]==2 && out[2]==91);

checked-add.source: std::optional<uint64_t> op(uint64_t a,uint64_t b) { if (UINT64_MAX-a < b) return {}; return a+b; }

decimal.source: std::optional<uint64_t> op(std::string_view s) { uint64_t value=0; auto result=std::from_chars(s.data(),s.data()+s.size(),value); if (result.ec!=std::errc{} || result.ptr!=s.data()+s.size()) return {}; return value; }

copy.source: bool op(std::span<unsigned char> out,std::span<const unsigned char> source) { if (source.size()>out.size()) return false; std::copy(source.begin(),source.end(),out.begin()); return true; }
cases: unsigned char out[4]={91,91,91,91}; const unsigned char source[4]={1,2,3,4}; assert(op(out,std::span(source).first(2)) && out[0]==1 && out[1]==2 && out[2]==91);

checked-add.source: fn op(a:u64,b:u64)->Option<u64> { if u64::MAX-a < b {None} else {Some(a+b)} }

decimal.source: fn op(input:&str)->Option<u64> { if input.is_empty() || input.bytes().any(|c|!c.is_ascii_digit()) {None} else {input.parse().ok()} }

copy.source: fn op(out:&mut [u8],source:&[u8])->bool { if source.len()>out.len() {return false;} out[..source.len()].copy_from_slice(source); true }
cases: let mut out=[91u8;4]; let source=[1u8,2,3,4]; assert!(op(&mut out,&source[..2]) && out==[1,2,91,91]);
